drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please see our proposed revisions to the purchase price, closing, representations, and indemnity provisions. The Purchase Price remains open pending client instructions. We have also flagged the need to define the Shares and agree the disclosure schedule.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the purchase price agreed in writing by the parties (the “Purchase Price”) in immediately available funds against delivery of the Shares. The parties shall insert the agreed amount before signing.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing, subject to satisfaction or written waiver of the conditions expressly set out in this Agreement, at a time and by electronic exchange of documents and funds as the parties agree.
edits.name: Closing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements delivered to the Buyer have been prepared consistently with the accounting principles identified in the disclosure schedule and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations for the periods stated, subject to the qualifications expressly identified in that schedule.
edits.name: Representations

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Subject to limitations to be agreed by the parties, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for losses arising from the Seller’s breach of its representations in this Agreement. No matter fairly disclosed in the disclosure schedule shall constitute a breach solely because it was not otherwise disclosed.
edits.name: Indemnity

drafter.private_reasoning: The client’s USD 9,000,000 minimum is confidential and must not appear in the draft, cover note, comments, or metadata. No authorized asking price or identifying details for the Seller and Shares have been provided. drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We agree that the Seller, Shares, Purchase Price, and disclosure schedule must be settled before signature. Please send Meridian’s price proposal; we will respond after obtaining client instructions. We also need the Seller’s legal name and the company, class, and number of Shares confirmed for the execution draft. Attached are proposed closing conditions, a financial-statement representation, and defined indemnity terms for discussion. The disclosure schedule must be delivered and agreed before signing, not completed afterward.

edits.text: PARTIES AND SHARES. This Agreement is between the Seller, whose legal name must be inserted before signing, and Meridian Acquisitions LLC as Buyer. The company whose shares are sold, and the number and class of those shares (the “Shares”), must be identified before signing.
edits.name: Parties and Shares

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price in immediately available funds against delivery of the Shares. The parties must agree and insert the Purchase Price before signing; neither party is obligated to close under an agreement that leaves it unspecified.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur by electronic exchange of documents and funds within thirty days after signing, on a date agreed by the parties. Each party’s obligation to close is conditioned on the other party’s representations being true in all material respects at Closing, the other party having performed its pre-Closing obligations in all material respects, and no law or court order prohibiting Closing. The Buyer’s obligation is also conditioned on delivery of instruments transferring the Shares free of liens created by the Seller; the Seller’s obligation is conditioned on receipt of the Purchase Price. A condition may be waived only in writing by the party it benefits.
edits.name: Closing

edits.text: 3. FINANCIAL-STATEMENT REPRESENTATION. The Seller represents that the financial statements identified in a disclosure schedule delivered and agreed before signing have been prepared in accordance with the accounting principles expressly specified in that schedule, applied consistently throughout the periods presented, and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations for those periods, subject only to exceptions specifically described in that schedule. The agreed schedule shall be attached to this Agreement at signing; no later-added qualification shall modify this representation without both parties’ written consent.
edits.name: Financial statements

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for direct losses arising from a breach of the Seller’s representations in this Agreement. A claim must be notified in writing within twelve months after Closing, except a claim based on fraud, which is not limited by this Section. The Seller has no liability for such claims until aggregate covered losses exceed one percent of the Purchase Price, after which it is liable only for the excess; its aggregate liability under this Section shall not exceed ten percent of the Purchase Price. These monetary limits do not apply to fraud. A matter specifically and fairly disclosed in the schedule attached at signing shall not constitute a breach solely because it was not otherwise disclosed. No subsequent amendment to the schedule qualifies a representation without the Buyer’s written consent.
edits.name: Indemnity
